description: City will introduce new rules for horse-drawn vehicles.
Amends Traffic Bylaw No. 7200 for horse-drawn vehicles.

chips.text: Operators of horse-drawn vehicles will be subject to new regulations.

description: Saskatoon will pilot removing pay stations on Central Avenue.
Traffic Bylaw 7200 will be amended for this pilot.
Traffic Bylaw 7200 fines will be amended.
On-street loading zone fees will be adjusted.
Accessible parking zone fees will be adjusted.

chips.text: Impacts individuals requiring accessible on-street parking.

description: Council to approve full reconstruction of 51st Street and Millar Avenue.
Approves 'Pathway Both Sides' design for Millar Avenue improvements.
Council will be informed by two reports.
